findings.highlight: They all gave up their lives so that one person might live.
findings.evidenceJa: みんなを犠牲にして、一人分だけ、救える席が出来ただけだ。
findings.governingReading: みんなを犠牲にして describes others sacrificed to free a single saving place, survivor-guilt reckoning.
findings.explanation: Everyone sacrificed becomes everyone voluntarily gave up life.

findings.highlight: rejected what he'd been fighting for
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの戦いが間違っていたと否定し
findings.governingReading: 自らの戦いが間違っていたと否定し says Kiritsugu recognizes his own struggle was wrong.
findings.explanation: Repudiating his struggle as wrong becomes rejecting its goal.

findings.evidenceJa: 新しい道を共に歩かせた。
findings.governingReading: 共に歩かせた keeps shared life with Kiritsugu, lost when guide dies7.
findings.explanation: Walking new path together becomes being shown new path.

findings.highlight: He showed you a dream as he walked ahead of you, and then he died.
findings.evidenceJa: 君に夢を見て亡くなった。
findings.governingReading: 君に夢を見て means seeing hope/dream in Shirou, died entrusting future fulfillment to him.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu placing a dream in the boy becomes showing the boy a dream.

findings.highlight: You've spent your entire life trying to redeem yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: 一生をかけて贖い続けなくてはいけない。
findings.governingReading: 一生をかけて贖い続けなくてはいけない ongoing prospective obligation for rejection.
findings.explanation: Must atone for whole remaining life becomes has atoned all prior life.

findings.highlight: You've killed yourself for the last ten years, believing in that idea.
findings.evidenceJa: 十年間信じ続けた自分を殺した。
findings.governingReading: 十年間信じ続けた modifies the former self he has now killed/rejected.
findings.explanation: Killed self believed for ten years becomes killed self throughout ten years of believing.

findings.highlight: It's pointless to mourn a saint.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖者の埋葬など無駄なこと。
findings.governingReading: 埋葬 withたて ruby presents the protective burial/shield image immediately before inevitable graft erosion; no act of mourning a saint.
findings.explanation: Saint’s burial with shield reading becomes mourning saint.

findings.highlight: Even if you were to lose your life that hangs by a thread, you will not simply die.
findings.evidenceJa: たかが片腕、命を取り留めた今では無くしたとしても死ぬ事はない。
findings.governingReading: たかが片腕…今では無くしたとしても死ぬ事はない says now life saved, loss of just one arm need not kill him.
findings.explanation: Losing arm after saving life becomes losing precarious life without dying.
